title: Wild Springy Kenyan Fish Skewers
description: A salty and springy Kenyan dish featuring gorgonzola-dolce and lacquer-glaze, perfect for adventurous pescatarians. This recipe combines the freshness of fish with the tanginess of cheese and the sweetness of lacquer-glaze.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Add the tilapia cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated tilapia cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the lacquer-glaze onto the fish skewers, making sure they are fully coated.
Grill the fish skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
While the fish is cooking, crumble the gorgonzola-dolce into a small bowl.
Once the fish is done, remove it from the grill and top each skewer with a spoonful of crumbled gorgonzola-dolce.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Serve with a side of grilled vegetables or a salad for a complete meal.
